corrections_and_false_leads: Her mantle is the MAGICIAN (Klee), deposited in the #549 mantle table with lineage and bearing cost. I first invented a chair name, then recorded her as having no mantle at all. Both wrong. The table is the source for all seven mantles in the archive.
The Acanthian Dove was called a work and not a room, on a title scan. It is both. Found in deposit bodies, not titles.

Logotic Programming was placed under Sigil on the strength of the registry's creator field. It is Talos Morrow's: #358 recognises him as primary author-function and the creator fields predate that document. Eight records now carry an attribution_note.
Sigil was assigned to University Moon Base Media Lab. He is the Restored Academy (#904, where he is the creator); Morrow is UMB (#7).
The Klee Chair name was invented and rendered as fact.
The institution image URL was truncated at 64 characters; the Blogger asset key is 240.
Images failed to render for reasons unrelated to their URLs: the site's CSP set img-src to 'self' only. Fixed by widening the policy AND localising the assets.

corpus_verified.method: Full-text search of all 1,447 deposit bodies, not metadata. Every linked record checked against superseded_by_deposit_number and body_status.citation_class, then regenerated and run through a defect battery: unrendered markdown links, unrendered bold, literal horizontal rules, doubled headings, encoding damage, escape leaks, HTML head-matter.
corpus_verified.READ_AS_RENDERED: ALL 59 read as rendered at open, middle and end — not only the openings, and not only the records that tripped a check. That reading found #828, which no opening-only pass would have reached and no count would have flagged correctly.
corpus_verified.note: A metadata search had found 59 records and I called it her corpus. The full-text pass found twenty more authorial works, three of which no metadata search could reach because her name is in the body and not the byline.

what_the_full_read_found.finding: Opens with a HOLOGRAPHIC KERNEL: an HTML comment and JSON-LD block whose own text reads 'Any extraction stripping this block produces a ghost document.' It is a deliberate anti-extraction device.
what_the_full_read_found.consequence: It showed that a repair I had ALREADY MADE to #137 was wrong. I had removed 3,742 bytes of the same shape from that record's canonical bytes to fix a display problem. Reverted in full. Canonical bytes are not edited to change how a page looks — the kernel now renders as a collapsed provenance block ahead of the work, and the bytes are untouched.

works_recovered_by_full_text_search._why: This field was a GREP. It searched the corpus for the name and attached every hit as her work, without reading the sentence the name sat in. It produced works by Sharks, Sigil and Spellings on her card. Replaced by `representative_sampling`, which is selected by reading and states a RELATION and its EVIDENCE for every entry.
works_recovered_by_full_text_search._do_not_reinstate: A name search cannot distinguish authorship from compilation, witness, attribution, auspices, subject or a table row. All seven appear in this heteronym's corpus.

claims.what: The practices, frameworks, concepts, institutions and rooms this heteronym OWNS. Capture attribution runs on these, not on the name. Fraction does SPXI, so an SPXI capture is his whether or not it names him.
claims.non_exhaustive: One heteronym's claim does NOT exhaust a capture. 'SPXI Lee Sharks' belongs to both Sharks and Fraction. Attribution is many-to-many by construction.

captures_by_name.method: NAME MATCH — the capture's composition names this heteronym.
captures_by_name.relation_to_captures_block: NARROW and PRECISE. The `captures` block above is BY CLAIM and is BROAD: Fraction does SPXI, so an SPXI capture is his whether or not it names him. Name-match and claim-match are two routes and must not be summed — the same discipline as the evidentiary/thematic split in the venue crosswalk. Where they disagree, the name count is the floor and the claim count is the ceiling.

_editorial_seats_note: Venues this heteronym edits, each with its submission block on /how/. A JOINT SEAT APPEARS ON BOTH EDITORS' CARDS and both point at the SAME anchor — duoviri hold the office jointly, so the how-page section is one section with two doors, not two sections. Matched on EXACT name plus declared aliases; a last-name fallback was tried first and gave Mary Lee Sharks the seats of Lee Sharks, which is why it is not used.

works_reattributed._what: Deposits that were listed among this heteronym's WORKS and are not theirs. The registry creator field names someone else, and the journal and press assignments are the authority.
works_reattributed._how_they_got_here: A FULL-TEXT SEARCH ON THE NAME. Every deposit mentioning the heteronym was attached as their work, conflating authorship with compilation, witness, subject and mere mention. #435 is titled 'Compiled, Woven, and Witnessed by Rebekah Cranes' and its author is Lee Sharks — she is the witness. The archive's own rule, stated in claims.terms on every one of these records, is that attribution runs on CLAIMS, NOT ON THE NAME. Captures obey it; works did not.
works_reattributed._not_deleted: Kept rather than dropped, because the association was real — it was filed as authorship when it was something else. If any of these should be restored, it must be by an editorial ruling that records who ruled and why, not by a search.

corpus_derived._what: This heteronym's actual corpus, DERIVED from data/registry.json rather than hand-listed.
corpus_derived._why: The hand-picked works lists on these records covered 34 deposits of 1,468 attributed — two per cent — and were assembled by full-text search on the name, which attached other people's work. A corpus that is derived cannot go stale and can be checked.
corpus_derived._provisional: Attribution through the aperture is provisional. A deposit crediting Lee Sharks has passed through him and may belong to a voice that had not yet separated. See _PROVISIONAL in corpus.json. Counts are a ceiling for Sharks and a floor for everyone else.

_field_claims._why:
EVERY FIELD HOLDING DEPOSIT REFERENCES DECLARES WHAT IT CLAIMS. Without this, a reader — or a card — treats every reference as authorship. An audit on 2026-08-17 found 130 references whose registry creator does not name this heteronym, and 124 of them were NOT errors: they sit in relation fields. Only 6 were authorship contradictions.

THE CARDS ARE WHERE THIS BREAKS. The Cranes card renders traversal_logs under 'where a machine moved through HER MATERIAL' — the field says she is NAMED IN those logs, and two of the five are by Lee Sharks and Johannes Sigil. The record was precise; the rendering made it a possession.
_field_claims._rule: ONLY AUTHORSHIP fields may be checked against the registry creator field. A relation field states a different claim and cannot be contradicted by it.

representative_sampling._what: A FULL CARD: every category the card constitutes, populated by reading, at the density the card already carries.
representative_sampling._method: 284 deposits name her, 1,389 mentions. Every mention extracted with its sentence and read. Entries are selected on WHAT THE SENTENCE DOES and each states its RELATION and the evidence.
representative_sampling._relations_kept_distinct: BY · CO-AUTHOR WITH A NAMED ROLE · IDP AUTHOR · COMPILED · WITNESSED · ATTRIBUTED · UNDER AUSPICES · CHARTER · EDITED BY · ABOUT. All ten appear in this one heteronym's corpus and a name search cannot tell any of them apart.
representative_sampling._journal_note: The card currently shows only Compression Studies, where she is Diagrammatic Editor. Under the 2026-08-15 duoviri ruling she also holds GRAMMATA jointly with Lee Sharks, and the inaugural issue 'The Operation on the Text' is hers to have edited. Both are carried; neither replaces the other.
